note: Produbanco only: Banco Pichincha's site lists its cards without a tariff the request reached, Banco Guayaquil's home page links none and Banco del Pacífico's didn't answer. Produbanco's card tariffs (in force October 2026) and its card interest rates (in force from 2 October 2026), read in full: every personal Visa and Mastercard named in its table of reward-program and benefits-abroad charges (28 cards; the Visa Pyme and Visa Corporativa, business cards, aren't written). Maintaining a credit card costs nothing, and revolving consumer credit bears up to 16.77% a year effective, the Central Bank's ceiling for consumer credit, on every card. The reward-program and benefits-abroad charges (54 to 7 dollars before VAT, by the card's segment) don't state their period and aren't written; nor are the out-of-court collection charges, set by days overdue and the instalment's size, or the late-payment surcharge on the rate. No minimum payment, grace period or foreign transaction fee is stated.
